description: Multi-environment HTTP proxy manager: one environment per port, several environments running at once.
post_install: Set-Content -LiteralPath "$dir\envboard.portable" -Value 'envboard portable marker (created by scoop); state: persist/envboard/envboard-data' -Encoding ascii
notes: Requires the WebView2 runtime (already present on most Windows 10/11 machines).
This is the portable build: state (ledger, rules, shared CA, lock) lives in $persist_dir\envboard-data and survives 'scoop update'.
Portable form runs as its own instance: window title is suffixed '(portable)', default port range is 17000-17999, and the WebView2 profile is separate, so it can run alongside the installer build.

Upgrading from a build that stored state in %LOCALAPPDATA%\envboard? Close envboard, then move that folder to $persist_dir\envboard-data before the first launch; otherwise you start with an empty environment list.
